release_notes:
• Four switchable player pages: Vinyl Center, Disc Top, Text First and Compact — choose them in Settings → Player UI & Customizer
• Compact page uses a clean artwork card and hides the turntable speed bar
• Fixed the Disc Vertical Position row: every chip now sits on one line with equal width
• Same single-line fix applied to the opacity, rotation speed, brake and crossfade chip rows
